title: The Long Way Round
text: God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines, though it was shorter.

title: Arrayed for Battle
text: And the Israelites left the land of Egypt arrayed for battle.

title: A Pillar of Cloud
text: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night …

title: It Never Left
text: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.

title: Pharaoh Changed His Mind
text: Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, “What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.”

title: Terrified
text: … they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

title: No Graves in Egypt?
text: Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us into the wilderness to die?

title: Do Not Be Afraid
text: Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation …

title: The LORD Will Fight for You
text: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.

title: Divide the Sea
text: … lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it, so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.

title: The Cloud Moved Behind
text: The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them, so that it came between the camps of Egypt and Israel.

title: A Strong East Wind
text: … all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land.

title: Walls of Water
text: … and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.

title: On Dry Ground
text: But the Israelites had walked through the sea on dry ground …

title: Wobbling Wheels
text: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving.

title: The LORD Is Fighting for Them
text: Let us flee from the Israelites, | for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!

title: The Sea Returned
text: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea returned to its normal state.

title: They Believed
text: … the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.

title: Miriam's Tambourine
text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand …

title: I Will Sing to the LORD
text: I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted.

title: My Strength and My Song
text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.

title: The LORD Is a Warrior
text: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.

title: By Faith
text: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land …

title: Terrified
text: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up and saw the Egyptians marching after them, and they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

title: Dancing with Tambourines
text: … and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.

title: Walls of Water
text: … with walls of water on their right and on their left.

title: Joseph's Bones
text: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him …
